name: – Andrzej Halicki – Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: REPORT on the Council position on Draft amending budget No 1/2026 of the European Union for the financial year 2026 entering the surplus of the financial year 2025
part_text:
The European Union ended 2025 with about 2.1 billion euros left over. This report agrees to put that money into the 2026 budget. It also sets out Parliament's views: it regrets that this lowers what member states pay in, wants leftover money from fines used as extra income, and calls for new sources of money for the Union of at least 60 billion euros a year for the next long-term budget.

- The 2025 leftover of about 2.1 billion euros goes into the 2026 budget.
- Member states pay less into the 2026 budget by the same amount.
- Parliament approves the plan; the budget is then final and published.
